scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build:backend: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
